about: Plain-words labels for AWS resource types, for UIs that show a resource to someone who does not know AWS (viz.aws.a's storyboard 02, the Vault deploy). Keyed by CloudFormation type; graph node types map through cfn_type. label: what it is for a person; short: two or three words for a small box; aws: the AWS name, shown second. By ontology.aws.a@SovereignWebsite.dinis, 23 Nov 2026. Plain British English; to change a label, change it here so every view agrees.

AWS::CloudFront::Distribution.label: Front door that serves the site to visitors, fast, from near them

AWS::Route53::RecordSet.label: One entry in the address book: sends a web address to the front door

AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate.label: Padlock certificate, so the address opens over HTTPS

AWS::Lambda::Function.label: Small program that runs only when asked

AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi.label: Entrance for the vault's requests, passed on to its programs

AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api.label: Entrance for the vault's requests, passed on to its programs

AWS::IAM::Role.label: Permission badge a service wears to do its job

AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy.label: List of what a badge allows

AWS::CloudFormation::Stack.label: Recipe that built these resources, and can change or remove them together

AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream.label: Conveyor that carries visit logs into the log store

AWS::CloudTrail::Trail.label: Diary of every change made in the account

AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm.label: Alarm that rings when something crosses a line
